reason: B is the better proposal because thermomechanically assisted precipitation is a physically established route and directly compares processed and cast/homogenized states through tensile, creep, TEM, and EBSD measurements. Both hypotheses fail to specify an alloy chemistry and cite no prior evidence, but A additionally assumes without support that 1–2 at.% W will form stable nanoscale Laves precipitates and uses an arbitrary >20% threshold.
